## Summary

Describe the problem, root cause, and focused solution.

## Verification

List the checks and acceptance layers that actually ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The implementation is focused and avoids unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Contract/sentinel coverage was assessed when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation impact was assessed and affected docs were updated.
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, or sensitive production data are included.
- [ ] No unnecessary generated files or production build artifacts are committed.
